show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Top Ten Lessons After Almost a Year - [Invest Like the Best, EP.44]
summary: And seemingly, every new tool and data source makes the problem even worse, adding more complexity, more headcount, and more risk. I know firsthand how complex the tech stack is for asset management firms. Ridgeline offers a better way forward, one unified platform that automates away the complexity across portfolio accounting, reconciliation, reporting, trading, compliance, and more, all at scale.

reader_summary.overview: I'm Patrick O'Shaughnessy, and this is Invest like the Best.
